headline: Google cuts free Gemini users down to its smallest model, Flash-Lite
body: Google will restrict Gemini access for personal accounts starting in October 2026: free users get only the smallest model, Flash-Lite, down from the current free tier's access to Flash and varying access to Pro. AI Plus subscribers at $4.99 a month keep Flash-Lite and Flash but lose Pro, and all three models now require AI Pro at $19.99 a month or AI Ultra at $99.99 or $199.99 a month.
note: Banks and insurers piloting Gemini on free or low-cost accounts for internal tools now need a paid plan to keep using anything beyond the smallest model, a sign AI labs are starting to charge more for capability as the technology matures.

evidence.text: Starting in October 2026, Google will restrict access to its Gemini models for personal account users.
Without a subscription, users will only get the smallest model, "Flash-Lite."
The more powerful "Flash" and "Pro" won't be included.
That's a cut from the current free tier, which offers access to 3.6 Flash and varying access to 3.1 Pro.
AI Plus subscribers ($4.99/month) lose access to Pro and can only use Flash-Lite and Flash.
All three models require AI Pro ($19.99/month) or AI Ultra ($99.99 or $199.99/month).
